note: Patches other mods make to the same code, the same way, as one of our switches. Exactly one copy may run: while the other mod's patch is active (installed, its mixin listed for this side, its option on), our switch steps aside; otherwise our switch applies and the other mod's mixin is cancelled. See bons.furious.guard.ForeignPatches. Checked against Collections Of Optimizations 4.4 (CurseForge file 9026925, sha1 d1b067885b0827c12b7eb75bc02896d270adaed8) on 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-03 (1.0.28), GeckoBetterFPS 1.0.2 (1.0.28), ServerCore 1.5.2 (2026-10-04), and Collections Of Optimizations 4.6 (CurseForge file 9069255, sha1 6af9f690130f77ccff43abda949a58171f396afe) on 2026-10-09 (1.0.36). Rechecked against Collections Of Optimizations 5.1 (CurseForge file 9253710, sha1 3276ac93dce1714dfb6ce6eb98c4dad92373a1f4) on 2026-10-19 (1.0.45): 60 rows added: 21 for options COO 4.7-5.1 added that make the same change as an existing switch, 39 for the switches new in 1.0.45 whose COO 5.1 counterpart patches the same method. Since 1.0.45 a row also needs the other mod's own mixin plugin to apply the mixin (ForeignPatches asks it through Mixin): COO 4.7 and later leave out their copies of several of these patches next to Bons and Furious, and our switch then applies instead of stepping aside for a copy that never runs. Rechecked on 2026-10-28 (1.0.48) against Collections Of Optimizations 5.6, 5.7 and 5.8 (CurseForge files 9334551, 9338915, 9341211, sha1 0ab991fe, 493b4eee, 2581bae6) and Lithoform 2.0.0: two rows added for patches that change the same method in a way that cannot run together with ours ("conflict": the method; Mixin refuses an injector into a method another mixin merged at the same or a higher priority), the crash class of the 1.0.26 magnet row. Rechecked on 2026-10-28 (1.0.49) against Collections Of Optimizations 5.8: a defensive conflict row for vanilla_climate_sample_xz_parts, whose method COO 5.6 and later @Overwrite (MixinClimateSampler, left out by COO next to Bons and Furious today).

yields.name: Lithoform
yields.why: Lithoform 2.0.0 (alpha8 and later) @Redirects the biome lookup (Supplier.get) in NamespacedRule.tryApply to skip it when the namespace map is empty. Lithoform has no option for it and no mixin plugin, so this switch steps aside whenever Lithoform lists the mixin; Lithoform's mixin is left out whenever ours applies.

yields.name: Collections Of Optimizations

This switch @Redirects the six DensityFunction.compute calls inside that method at the same priority, and Mixin refuses an injector into a method another mixin merged at the same or a higher priority, whatever require says (InvalidInjectionException 'cannot inject into ... merged by MixinClimateSampler'): the game would stop when Climate.Sampler loads, at every world start. COO 5.6-5.8 leave this mixin out next to Bons and Furious (it is on their own list), so today only this switch runs; the row keeps it that way if COO's mixin plugin ever applies it. An @Overwrite conflicts whenever it applies, whatever the options say, so the row names no option: this switch steps aside whenever COO's plugin applies the mixin, and otherwise applies and leaves COO's mixin out. Found by the static sweep of 1.0.48 against COO 5.6-5.8 (2026-10-28).

yields.why: Valkyrien Skies 2 (2.4.11 checked) merges its own clip into Level (feature.clip_replace.MixinLevel in valkyrienskies-common.mixins.json, applied whenever Valkyrien Skies is installed), so ray clips can hit ships. This switch walks Touch'n Motion's ground probes with vanilla's block traversal instead of Level.clip and steps aside, at run time, for every level class that carries another mod's clip; with Valkyrien Skies that is every level, where the hand-over costs more than the stock probe (measured 0.95x). So this switch steps aside at load, and applies no handler, whenever Valkyrien Skies' own mixin plugin applies that mixin (Valkyrien Skies has no option for it); otherwise it applies, and the run-time check stays for clip-merging mods this row does not name.

While that option is on and COO's own mixin plugin applies its copy, this switch steps aside; otherwise this switch applies and COO's copy is left out, so only one copy runs.

While that option is on and COO's own mixin plugin applies its copy, this switch steps aside; otherwise this switch applies and COO's copy is left out, so only one copy runs.

While that option is on and COO's own mixin plugin applies its copy, this switch steps aside; otherwise this switch applies and COO's copy is left out, so only one copy runs.

While that option is on and COO's own mixin plugin applies its copy, this switch steps aside; otherwise this switch applies and COO's copy is left out, so only one copy runs.
